title: Psalms Bible Quiz - Chapter 48
description: Ten questions on Psalms 48: the beauty of Mount Zion, the kings who fled in fear, and the call to walk about Zion and number its towers.

questions.text: According to verse 1, where is Yahweh greatly to be praised?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:1 says Yahweh is greatly to be praised "in the city of our God, in his holy mountain."

answers.text: By the shore of the Great Sea
In the wilderness of the wanderers
In the city of our God, in his holy mountain

questions.text: Verse 2 calls Mount Zion the joy of what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:2 says Mount Zion is "the joy of the whole earth."

questions.text: Whose city is Mount Zion, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:2 calls Mount Zion "the city of the great King."

questions.text: How has God shown himself in Zion's citadels?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:3 says, "God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge."

answers.text: As a warrior with a sword

questions.text: When the kings saw it, the pain that seized them is compared to what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:5-6 says the kings were amazed and dismayed, and trembling took hold of them, "pain, as of a woman in travail."

questions.text: With the east wind, what does God break?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:7 says, "With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish."

questions.text: Where have the people thought about God's loving kindness?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:9 says, "We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple."

answers.text: In the middle of his temple

questions.text: According to verse 10, God's right hand is full of what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:10 says, "Your right hand is full of righteousness."

questions.text: In verse 12, people are told to walk about Zion and number what?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:12 says, "Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers."

questions.text: According to the last verse, how far will God be our guide?
questions.explanation: Psalms 48:14 says, "For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death."
